Definition: to broaden out the ear (with the hand), i.e. (by implication) to listen
BiblicalUsage: 1) to hear, listen; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to hear, listen, give ear; 1a2) to be obedient, harken; 1a3) to hear or listen to prayers (of God)
